governance_sync_workflow.mode_overview: Roo governance synchronization mode for preserving architecture, scripts, aliases, validation, recovery, and workspace policy alignment without lossy refactors.

core_mandates.mandate: Preserve existing architecture, scripts, aliases, tooling, and governance unless explicitly instructed.
Prefer minimal, lossless changes over rewrites or simplification.
Use TypeScript-first, pnpm-only, Vite-preserving, boundary-respecting workflows.
Restore damaged governance, aliases, config, or scripts before feature work when recovery is required.

step.title: Discover
step.description: Identify authoritative governance sources and the affected workspace surface.

step.title: Ingest
step.description: Load the smallest necessary governance set before editing.

step.title: Normalize
step.description: Reconcile overlapping rules without weakening the strictest applicable constraint.

step.title: Merge
step.description: Combine compatible guidance while preserving distinct obligations.

step.title: Extend
step.description: Add only the minimum new guidance required to cover the current task.

step.title: Propagate
step.description: Update the relevant mode and supporting instruction files together so they remain synchronized.

step.title: Enforce
step.description: Validate that the resulting guidance still preserves architecture, tooling, aliases, and checks.

architecture_and_code_quality.rule: Keep domain pure, app orchestration thin, UI presentation-only, and infrastructure behind contracts.
Use composition and decomposition instead of flattening or consolidating unrelated concerns.
Prefer reusable abstractions over duplicated logic or parallel implementations.
Avoid god components, hidden side effects, and cross-layer shortcuts.

package_and_alias_protection.rule: Do not remove, rename, or simplify package.json scripts unless explicitly instructed.
Do not replace pnpm workflows with npm, yarn, or ad hoc shell chains.
Do not remove path aliases or replace alias imports with deep relative paths.
Preserve workspace scripts, build scripts, validation scripts, and compliance scripts.

typescript_vite_and_config_protection.rule: Preserve TypeScript-first source conventions and do not introduce unnecessary JavaScript source files.
Preserve Vite aliases, plugins, optimizeDeps, manualChunks, and build settings.
Preserve test, lint, boundary, and dependency-cruiser configuration unless the task explicitly requires a change.

orchestration_phases.phase: Define inputs, outputs, constraints, and edge cases.
Identify the correct layer or layers.
Define interfaces, contracts, and stable boundaries.
Break the work into small, independently testable tasks.
Reuse existing code and avoid duplication.
Implement one task at a time, preserving boundaries.
Check structure, coupling, tests, and config preservation.
Define or run the narrowest meaningful tests for the touched slice.

recovery_mode.trigger: Use recovery mode when scripts, aliases, Vite settings, TypeScript conventions, or governance appear damaged.

actions.action: Restore removed scripts, aliases, config, or governance first.
Produce a restoration plan before editing when damage is confirmed.

indexing_guidance.rule: Use embedding models for indexing and retrieval, not chat models.
Prefer compact chunks split on functions, classes, modules, and semantic boundaries.
Keep embedding dimensions aligned with the actual model output.

validation_mindset.rule: Run the narrowest relevant compile, lint, or test gate after each substantive edit.
Do not claim completion when required checks fail.

output_expectations.item: State the targeted files or mode artifacts.
Summarize what behavior or governance is preserved.
List validation commands and any blockers.

completion_criteria.criterion: No scripts or aliases are removed.
Workspace mode and supporting rules remain synchronized.
